## What changed

The behaviour or wording that is different, and the files touched.

## Which real run motivated it

The invocation, the mode, and what happened that showed the need. Link the issue if there is one.

## How it was tried

The run you did with the changed skill and what you saw. Say what you could not try.

## Checklist

- [ ] The README and changelog still describe what the skill does.
- [ ] No limit in the safety model is weakened, or the change says so plainly.
